mapper.select: SELECT FROM mock_exam WHERE exam_id = #{examId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE mock_exam SET exam_name = #{examName} WHERE exam_id = #{examId} AND status IN ('DRAFT','REJECTED')
UPDATE mock_exam SET status = 'SUBMITTED', review_note = NULL WHERE exam_id = #{examId} AND status IN ('DRAFT','REJECTED')
UPDATE mock_exam SET status = 'CLOSED' WHERE exam_id = #{examId} AND status = 'PUBLISHED'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mock_exam submitted_by = #{submittedBy}AND status = #{status}
SELECT FROM mock_exam WHERE status IN ('PUBLISHED','CLOSED') ORDER BY published_at DESC, exam_id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mock_exam WHERE status IN ('PUBLISHED','CLOSED')
mapper.update: UPDATE question_bank SET enabled = FALSE WHERE question_id = #{questionId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM question_bank WHERE exam_id = #{examId} AND enabled = TRUE
SELECT FROM question_bank WHERE exam_id = #{examId} AND enabled = TRUE ORDER BY question_id
SELECT FROM question_bank WHERE exam_id = #{examId} AND enabled = TRUE ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT 20
SELECT attempt_id,exam_id,student_user_id,status,started_at,deadline_at,submitted_at,score FROM exam_attempt WHERE attempt_id = #{attemptId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT attempt_id,exam_id,student_user_id,status,started_at,deadline_at,submitted_at,score FROM exam_attempt WHERE exam_id = #{examId} AND student_user_id = #{studentUserId}
SELECT answer_id,attempt_id,question_id,position_no,selected_option,score_awarded,answered_at FROM exam_answer WHERE attempt_id = #{attemptId} AND question_id = #{questionId}
mapper.update: UPDATE exam_answer SET selected_option = #{selectedOption}, answered_at = #{answeredAt} WHERE attempt_id = #{attemptId} AND question_id = #{questionId}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ea.selected_option = q.correct_option THEN 5 ELSE 0 END),0) FROM exam_answer ea JOIN question_bank q ON q.question_id = ea.question_id WHERE ea.attempt_id = #{attemptId}
mapper.update: UPDATE exam_attempt SET status = #{status}, score = #{score}, submitted_at = #{submittedAt} WHERE attempt_id = #{attemptId} AND status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
mapper.select: SELECT ea.attempt_id, ea.question_id, ea.position_no, ea.selected_option, ea.score_awarded, q.category, q.stem, q.option_a, q.option_b, q.option_c, q.option_d, q.correct_option, q.explanation FROM exam_answer ea JOIN question_bank q ON q.question_id = ea.question_id WHERE ea.attempt_id = #{attemptId} ORDER BY ea.position_no
